topic: Apple is launching eight new products before the end of September 2026: Mac mini (M6/M5 Pro) and Mac Studio (M5 Max/Ultra) ship Sept 22; iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, the first foldable iPhone, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5 are expected at the Sept 9 'Surprise and shine' event
details: Primary trigger: MacRumors (Tim Hardwick), Sept 2 2026, https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/02/apple-launching-eight-new-products-next-month/ . Mac mini/Studio are OFFICIAL (Apple already announced + priced + dated, shipping Sept 22). The Sept 9 event lineup is RUMOR/multi-sourced (MacRumors/9to5Mac), not yet confirmed by Apple beyond the date+tagline. Do not conflate confirmed Mac launches with rumored Sept 9 lineup in narration.
